title: The Marshal's Oath thread (Tanners' Row burn-order) was left open at game's end with no in-throne-room way to resolve it; the ending epilogue never mentions what became of it, though the quest text implied 'Take it to Tarn, to the Regent, or sell it to Quill - each closes this differently.'
